title: Discernment
paragraphs: "Well, yeah. That said, the guys who belonged to the Takt faction were armed, and they sniped at us a lot during the war, so I think they'll come from that direction. Just to be safe, I'll go in alone and make my presence known, so if they attack, please pinpoint their location."
"Got it! Destroy!"
“Motoyasu, go easy on them, okay? We’re just capturing them to make them spill the beans on where our comrades are.”
“Of course. My spear will roar!”
I’m sure there’ll be plenty of pigs around. I’ll capture a bunch and make it the Pig King’s turn.
“No matter how I look at it, you’ll probably kill them before they confess… I’m really counting on you here.”
“Of course.”
“I’m a little worried, but… Rasa-san, I’m counting on you.”
“Don’t ask me to do the impossible!”
What on earth are you asking a panda to do? As long as I’m here, everything will be fine! Where are they coming from? Let’s check our surroundings so we’re ready to move immediately.
“Um… Yuki-chan and Kou don’t seem like they’ll be much help, and Sakura-chan definitely can’t handle this… Well, let’s just say we picked the wrong opponent this time.”
“You don’t think Yuki is reliable?”
“So, Yuki-chan, can you stop Motoyasu-kun from going on a rampage right now?”
“Why do I have to stop him?”
“……Rasa-san, please.”
“I get that you’re counting on me because I’m the only one here besides you who could stop him… but you really need to face reality here.”

Father let out a deep sigh as he headed out of the plane first, stepping through the door, raising one hand, and smiling as he made his way down the stairs. It looked like his smile was a bit forced, but I suppose he was just nervous.
Just as he was about three steps from the bottom of the stairs, a particularly large bullet whizzed past, aimed right at the space between Father’s eyebrows.

That looked a lot like… the bullets from a weapon called an “anti-materiel rifle,” which some military buff once raved about to me. At the very least, there’s no doubt it was a full size larger than any bullets the guys under Takt’s command had been carrying. That bullet flew at an incredible speed, struck Father right between the eyes… and bounced off with a “thud.”
“Ouch… that actually hurt a little!”

By the way, Father spent a little time leveling up after the war and has improved his stats quite a bit. I was staring intently at the rippling air, so I was able to clearly track where the shot came from.

But… it was fired from incredibly far away. I can tell he’s at least a kilometer away. If he managed to hit Father right between the eyes from that distance, that makes him a sniper on par with Itsuki!

If the rifle this sniper used was the kind I’m familiar with, I recall hearing that its maximum range is 4,500 meters. Of course, I’d expect the damage to drop if fired at maximum range, so I’d estimate it was around 2 kilometers. But given the effects of level and Magic, it’s also possible they attacked from even farther away.

Even using Motoyasu’s Eye to its fullest, it’ll take time to pinpoint the target. Plus, there’s a high chance they’ll fire continuously, so we need to take them out quickly. Firing the Aiming Lancer or Gungnir is a good option, but we can’t lock on unless we spot the target first.
“Father! Are you okay!?”
“Yeah, it just hurt a little. But… preparing something like this? That’s a pretty rough welcome.”
“Enemy attack! Enemy attack! Shieldfreeden, capture the traitors who defy the will of Siltvelt and mete out punishment!”
“It’s highly likely they’re already planning a retreat. After all, they’re attacking from this far away.”
Father turns his gaze toward the confused onlookers. Ah, so he thought they’d be coming from there.
“Either way, we know which direction the enemy is coming from. Since it’s hard for me to tell if it’s a pig, and the distance makes it dangerous to fire without aiming properly, I’ll use this.”
“This?”
I’ll focus my mind and cast Magic. With this Magic, I can perfectly track the bullet’s trajectory… it’ll even serve as a laser sight.

“I, The Love Hunter, command the heavens and the earth; I shall sever what is unreasonable, reconnect what is broken, and expel the pus. O Power of the Dragon Vein. Unite with my Magical Power and the Hero’s strength; thus commands The Love Hunter, the very source of all power. Interpret the workings of the universe once more, and unleash the gaze that pierces all as a beam of heat!’
“Liberation Fire Eye!”

Putting all my might into it, I’ll unleash an ultra-thick beam from my eyes with Magic! Normally, I’d boost my power to X before firing, but since Father told me to go easy, I’ll tone it down by just using a regular Liberation. By the way, if I use the plural form—Al-Liberation Fire Eye—it becomes a spread beam. Of course… if I shake my head, I can just sweep it all away! Hahahahahahaha!
“Motoyasu Biiiiiiiinmu!”

Beep! My fiery gaze flies straight along the trajectory of the bullet that was heading toward the space between Father’s eyebrows. There was another gunshot along the way, but the bullet that was fired seems to have evaporated! Right where my intense gaze landed, something began to burst into flames.
“It’s over there!”
Having finished firing the Fire Eye, I pointed at the spot where the pillar of fire was rising and gave instructions to the crew.
“H-… Huh!”
The Demi-Humans, who had been stunned, heard my words and immediately began rushing toward the spot.
“Um… Motoyasu… it looked like you just used some really strange attack…”
“Oh? Was this your first time seeing my Fire Eye? It’s my original Magic!”
“No, that’s not what I meant to ask… The Motoyasu Beam… there are so many things to point out…”
“It’s pretty amazing in so many ways… You were already as strong as a demon god on the battlefield, but seeing it up close is something else. Is this the kind of attack you were using back then?”
“I wasn’t doing anything like this back then!”
Well, this world is still in the early stages of the loop, after all. I was still inexperienced back then. But things are different now.
“I’ve grown, you know!”
“I have a feeling we shouldn’t just brush this off as ‘growth,’ though…”
Oops, we must make the traitors and the Takt faction pay for their crimes. We’ve pinpointed their location, so let’s head there right away.
“Well then, Yuki-chan, let’s go and capture our target with style!”
“Understood!”

In response to my call, Yuki-chan transformed into her Filolial form. It would’ve been nice to switch to Drive Mode, but it doesn’t look like I’ll be able to get my hands on any tires. I guess I’ll have to think about developing a spear for Drive Mode next.
It’s a spear with tires attached to the sides. If I use Weapon Copy, I’ll be able to make one anytime. If used properly, we might even be able to pull off Car Mode and other forms!

With that thought in mind, I climbed onto Yuki-chan’s back and quickly dashed toward our destination. We sped past an airfield with a great view, leaped over a chain-link fence, and raced to the rooftop of a building engulfed in flames. There, I spotted what looked like the pig we were after. Though, there are a few others here, too.
Since this is a hassle, I’ll just use the Aiming Lancer—just enough to incapacitate them, not kill them. Their crime is simply being here. You’re all going to be crucified!
“Aiming Lancer!”
“Oooggghh!?”
“Gyaaaaaaah!”
I’ll throw my spear at the ones I’ve locked onto and use Aiming Lancer to incapacitate them. Oh? There’s a pig that’s moving better than I expected. This one’s probably the one.
“Paralyze Lance X!”
“Buh!? Oink—!?”
I swiftly speared the pig and paralyzed it. It’s rolling around pathetically. Off to the factory with you.
“Well then, let’s hand it over quickly. Yuki-chan, let’s hurry back to Father.”
“Yes, ma’am!”

Before long, the officials rushed over, so after handing over the most suspicious suspect, we headed back to Father. Father was moving toward the airport building while keeping an eye out for the sniper’s second unit and others.
“Motoyasu, you’re back already? That was quick.”
“Of course.”
“We solved it quickly.”
Yuki-chan is right. Just as Father and the others were about to head deeper into the building, Panda stopped them.
“What’s wrong?”
“Well, I’m not sure. I’ve got a strange hunch. It smells slightly like drugs, I guess.”
“Weren’t they just cleaning up because we were coming?”
“No, I’ve smelled this before. It smells like explosives.”

They really are a radical bunch, aren’t they? By the way, the effectiveness of bombs and the like is somewhat influenced by the Lv of the person who sets them off. Of course, the quality of the materials and such also plays a role. A shoddy product won’t pose a threat even at a high Lv. Well, since we can neutralize explosives with Magic, it’s no trouble at all for us. As for landmines… just like with the Crimson Swine, we’ll blow them to smithereens on the spot!
“That’s a bit too rough a welcome… I guess that’s what you’d expect from Takt’s home base, huh?”
“I wonder…”
Saying things like that, the panda dodged a nearby potted plant… and there it was. At a glance, you could tell there was a bomb and a detonator.
“Should I blast it away with Magic?”
“Hold on a sec. This is… hmm, hmm, like this.”
Panda used his claws to quickly and deftly dismantle the bomb. He’s surprisingly dexterous for someone with such big hands. And just like that, he defused the bomb.
“I remember seeing this kind of thing around the mercenary circles.”
“You’re quite the pro.”

“Well, I’m a mercenary. I sell stuff like this to all sorts of countries to make a buck. Weapons, Ren… if you’ve dabbled in anything even a little, you know its value and can turn it into cash. And you know where to sell it, too.”

This is one of Panda’s hidden talents. Working as a vendor alongside Keel… I guess being a “crowd-pleasing panda” isn’t his only job? Perhaps Father from the first world hired this panda precisely because of abilities like this.
“It looks like it could explode if remotely triggered.”

“That’s right. That’s why I wouldn’t recommend going any further inside. Since it’s a magical power-emitting type, it’d be fairly easy to neutralize it to some extent by altering the surrounding magic field.”
“Then this is it! Liberation Seal Fire Field V!”

With a flash, I deploy a light magical power field around us. Normally, this spell suppresses specific magical attributes. It’s not very effective against powerful casters, but since I’ve reinforced it sufficiently, it can significantly suppress the activation of ordinary magic.

The downside is that it’s several levels below the magic used to establish territories like Filolial’s or a dragon’s, so it can’t serve as a countermeasure. It’s not my specialty, but it should have some effect.
“This should prevent any signals from being received.”
“…Though there are some things that explode if they can’t receive a signal, you know…”
“Yikes!”
“You should’ve said that sooner.”
“Spear Hero, didn’t you go and use it on your own?! Fortunately, it doesn’t look like anything like that was set up, though.”
“Or maybe Motoyasu-kun’s Magic is suppressing them?”
“That’s possible, too. Anyway, we’d better find them and defuse them quickly.”

And so, with everyone—including the staff of Shieldfreeden—pitching in, we proceeded to defuse the explosives inside the building. Even the building’s own employees were surprised, wondering when all these devices had been planted.
The Takt faction’s ability to get things done is truly remarkable. There must be a mole among us. All we have to do is make the sniper pig we captured this time confess to reveal who that mole is.

And so, while receiving this rather rough welcome, we headed toward Shieldfreeden’s castle—the official residence where the leadership gathers—in the carriages that had been prepared for us. Oh, and of course, we checked them thoroughly to make sure no suspicious devices had been planted, so there’s no problem there.

By the way, it seems Shieldfreeden does have cars, but this time we asked Yuki-chan and the others—who are quick on their feet—to take us. We made our way through the capital-like townscape, which was quite a distance from the terminal.
“They’ve got paved roads like in Faubrey. Well, every country has cobblestone streets, though.”
“That’s true.”
“I’d say the level of civilization is pretty high, wouldn’t you? I even have an acquaintance who works as a mercenary around here.”
“Did you run into him on the battlefield?”
“Not this time. They’re a bunch of guys with an unnaturally sharp intuition.”
“Huh… By the way, what kind of work do mercenaries in this country do?”

“Well, since they’re mercenaries, most of them work as bodyguards. Other than that, I’d say a lot of them are temporary guards, wouldn’t you say? Trouble’s always lurking around every corner. If you’re strong, you’ll never be short on work, no matter where you go.”
Hmm, being a mercenary is no easy life. Still, since fighting is their business, it stands to reason they’d have to be strong.
“Sounds like the kind of mercenaries who believe ‘might makes right.’”
“Well, the really famous mercenaries would go to Faubrey or Zeltoble instead of coming here. You can make more money there.”
“Somehow… that makes this country sound like it’s missing something, no matter where you look.”
Well, it’s the country of Takt and his crew. That’s only to be expected.
